description: Works out how many months a loan takes to pay off and the total interest, month by month (one month of interest = APR / 12 is added, then the payment is taken off), and what an optional extra monthly payment saves in interest and time. Same method as https://profitdrawer.com/tools/loan-payoff-calculator.html. A close estimate; lenders can differ slightly.

apr_percent.description: Annual interest rate (APR) in percent, for example 6.

extra_payment.description: Optional extra payment each month in USD.

name: calculate_loan_payoff
title: Calculate loan payoff
